**M Jayachandran**

 
• M. Jayachandran is a prominent Indian music composer and playback singer in **Malayalam cinema.**
 
• He has won the Kerala State Film Award for **Best Music Director** nine times.
 
• Won the** National Film Award** for Best Music Direction in **2015 **for **Ennu Ninte Moideen**.
 
• Composed music for over 100 films, establishing a strong presence in the Malayalam film industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 **National Film Award** 

 
• The National Film Award is a prestigious honor in India that recognizes excellence in cinema across various categories.
 
• It is awarded by the Directorate of Film Festivals, which is part of the **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.**
 
• Winning this award is a significant achievement, as it highlights exceptional talent and contributions to the Indian film industry.
 
• The awards were** first instituted in 1954 **and have evolved over time, with changes in categories and criteria to reflect the growing diversity and complexity of Indian cinema.
